title: Name a set of steps
summary: PHP: Name a set of steps. Call twice with 7.
introduction: A function takes an input and can return a result. return sends the answer back.
learningObjectives: Name a set of steps with PHP

blocks.text: Install PHP 8.2 or later. Save each example as lesson.php and run php lesson.php. These are local programs, not a server for this learning site.

blocks.title: Name a set of steps
blocks.code:
<?php
function twice(int $n): int { return $n * 2; }
echo twice(4);

blocks.text: The input $n receives 4. return sends 8 back to the call for echo to display.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Printing inside a function and returning a value are different actions.
